image.plan: Mobile PDP for the cream 10.5 inch ceramic fry pan. First screen: outcome headline, product name, price, rating and review count, hero image, benefit chips, trust row, sticky add to cart. Below the fold: the non-toxic materials story, induction and oven-safe detail, a comparison, a real review, an FAQ.

image.note: This is the Caraway blocker. Do not ship the rebuild on the flat cutout.
